en: A black-and-white panoramic view over a small town nestled in a wooded valley with rolling hills and farmland in the background. A winding road and railway line pass through clusters of houses and industrial buildings with a tall chimney. The printed caption at the top in German reads 'Glashütte i. Sa. Blick vom Pilz'. The overall style and print quality suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
